# ContextualReasoning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capability of an AI system to interpret situational context and adapt its behavior accordingly, beyond fixed rule-based or statistical responses. Requires dynamic, stateful processing that iNEST's neuromorphic substrates can deliver through temporal dynamics and plasticity, unlike conventional static networks.
